name: smart-compact
description: Checkpoint a Claude Code session before compacting, compact it automatically, and rehydrate on your terms with a measured estimate of what comes back.

suggestAt.title: Suggest saving at (tokens)
suggestAt.description: Context size, in tokens, at which smart-compact suggests /smart-compact:save once. It never fires later than 60% of the point where Claude Code compacts on its own. 0 means that 60% point; -1 turns the suggestion off.

summaryContract.title: Summary contract on every compaction
summaryContract.description: Add the summary contract (standing rules, open decisions, counters, and the latest checkpoint's pointer) to every compaction, automatic ones included. The contract comes from the 'Summary contract' section of ~/.claude/smart-compact/profile.md when present.
